MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Smart Plug gives my existing Alexa devices a useful new job: controlling a lamp by voice, rather than repeating something I can already do.",
    "The Blink bundle feels like a natural extension of my earlier door alarms, with cameras and Alexa compatibility giving me a reason to explore it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The older Echo Show 5, Echo Dot and Fire TV sticks duplicate needs covered by my recently purchased devices, so their familiarity does not make them useful purchases now.",
    "The tablets do not answer a current need for me. Buying speakers and streaming equipment does not mean I am looking for another entertainment screen.",
    "The Show 8's larger screen interests me, but that interest is not enough to justify another display so soon after getting my Show 5."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My recent Amazon device purchases seem to have been treated as a reason to suggest more devices from the same family, even when they offer functions I already have.",
    "My interest in practical electronics seems to have been stretched into interest in tablets and a themed remote cover without a clear use for either."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The specific versions I recently bought matter: an older Dot, Show 5 or streaming stick offers little when I already have a newer version.",
    "My Show stand, replacement remote batteries and computer accessories suggest that helping my existing equipment work better can be more useful than adding another main device.",
    "Compatibility matters most when it enables something new, such as lamp control or connected cameras, rather than simply adding another Alexa screen or speaker."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my Alexa setup but missed that I currently value useful additions more than duplicate devices or unrelated entertainment screens."
}
